_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 006 data-model.md section 4 (006 task T031), for curation/equipment-overrides.json. Keyed (datasheet_id, line): a curator's resolution for a default-equipment sentence research D1e's compound-and-conditional tail left unresolved. THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO POINTS FIELD ANYWHERE IN THIS SCHEMA -- default equipment is what a model already carries and costs nothing by definition, so there is nowhere here for a number to go, and a schema with nowhere to put a price is a stronger control than a review rule saying not to. Likewise there is no description field: a sentence is a subject plus item names, which is what stops this class becoming a prose channel (Constitution Principle 4). Modelled on option-overrides.schema.json's shape so a curator who has written one has written both.
title: curation/equipment-overrides.json

line.description: the sentence's own ordinal within the composition block, which is also its display order and the source of its id

applies_to.description: Whom the sentence covers. An EXPLICIT code rather than the presence of composition_line, because a nullable link alone cannot tell 'this covers the whole unit' from 'this names a group nobody could identify', and 006 FR-015 requires those two to be distinguishable.

model_name.description: Present exactly when applies_to is model_group. A NAME, never prose.

composition_line.description: The datasheet's own composition row this sentence attaches to. Stated by the curator and USED, never re-derived: the pipeline resolves this link by name and omitted it here because it could not. Omit it when the sentence genuinely covers rows the source does not separate -- research D1e measured 195 cards where one sentence covers two composition rows, and on those the honest answer is applies_to = unit with no link at all.

items.description: The items the sentence names, in the source's own order. A stated weapon_line is USED and never re-derived.

count.description: Omit when the source states none. Absence means the source said nothing; 1 would be this repository saying it instead.

note.description: A curator's sentence about MECHANICS OR PROCESS. It must not quote source text.
